packages.label: Lattice Boltzmann flow and coupled transport
packages.scope: Independent 3-D low-Mach and compressible numerical-equilibrium flow; porous topology gradients, thermal exchange and supported one-way mechanics. Explicit provider validity limits apply; not reacting flow or universal supersonic qualification.

packages.label: Finite-deformation solid mechanics
packages.scope: Neo-Hookean, Maxwell and saturated poroviscoelastic histories; fixed-mesh material-field optimization with implicit derivatives. Thermal/Arrhenius/ageing and neutral chemical-swelling history evaluation. No contact, moving-boundary adjoint or mixed incompressibility.

packages.label: Resolved quasistatic electrical heating
packages.scope: Native potential/temperature coupling with charge conservation, temperature-dependent conductivity and Joule heat. Requires native host and electrode data; element assembly, power identities, derivatives, MMS spatial convergence, multi-step converged coupled histories and full-history adjoints are verified at the numerics tier; no experimental validation. No induction, phasors or contact resistance.

packages.label: Nonlinear kinematic plasticity
packages.scope: Native J2 multi-backstress Chaboche; user-authored material data, not calibrated fatigue life.

packages.label: Nonmultiplying multigroup neutral transport and deposition
packages.scope: Monolithic fixed-group isotropic transport, conservative local heating and optional material-state drive; processed user data required, no multiplication/depletion.

packages.label: Prescribed real electric-field thermal loading
packages.scope: One-way native-cell Joule heating from prescribed real endpoint fields and topology-interpolated whole-cell conductivity; no electrical field solve or temperature feedback.

packages.label: Prescribed material-resolved volumetric heating
packages.scope: One-way volumetric heating with power densities per solid endmember and fluid, occupancy/phase mixing, optional exponential depth attenuation from one face and a time factor; exact design derivatives. No radiation transport or temperature feedback.

packages.label: Quasistatic electromagnetic body loads
packages.scope: Native potential solve for eddy currents from a prescribed uniform dB/dt and current injected through equipotential face terminals; Lorentz body force J x B on the solid and optional Joule heat in the same history residual and adjoint. Quasistatic: no self-field, skin effect or motion EMF; user data required.

packages.label: Material history: environmental ageing and defect kinetics
packages.scope: Thermal, oxidative and hydrolytic extents plus prescribed-dose defect production/recovery; coupled conductivity, strength, creep and energy. User-calibrated local kinetics, not solved species transport, corrosion geometry or neutronics.

packages.label: Nonlinear tabulated solid material laws
packages.scope: User-supplied temperature tables, shape-preserving interpolation, exact enthalpy and thermal-strain integrals; no built-in material calibration.

packages.label: Liquid/vapour saturation and native liquid-history validity
packages.scope: IAPWS-IF97 water saturation line and complete-history liquid-only margins; not two-phase flow or CHF/DNBR.

packages.label: Shared-domain thermofluid and inelastic topology
packages.scope: Native common occupancy, shared thermal history and density-jump fluid stress. Laminar diffuse formulation, no production qualification.

packages.label: Native conjugate flow/heat/inelastic histories
packages.scope: Shared field/history solve with separately loaded solid, fluid and conservative interface components; fixed region partition.

packages.label: Resolved incompressible transport
packages.scope: Cartesian MAC laminar momentum, continuity, enthalpy and temperature-dependent Newtonian material; no boiling/turbulence.

packages.label: Conservative field interfaces
packages.scope: Conservative thermal-contact and fluid traction components; require host field integration.

packages.label: Reciprocal thermal boundary exchange
packages.scope: Newton heat-transfer and diffuse-gray radiation components with conservative finite-reservoir coupling; no forced-convection or view-factor closure.

packages.label: Native inelastic material components
packages.scope: Temperature-dependent solid properties, J2 mixed hardening and Norton creep. User material data required; no rupture calibration.

packages.label: Native coupled thermal/inelastic solids
packages.scope: 3-D small-strain thermal, plastic and creep history with discrete adjoints; separate material components required. Reference tetrahedral discretisation.

packages.label: Resolved Stokes–Brinkman flow
packages.scope: Isothermal, incompressible viscous flow; no turbulence, thermal or ageing model.

packages.label: Engineering reference physics library
packages.scope: Declared reference fields, networks, interfaces and constitutive add-ins.

packages.label: Moving material interface operators
packages.scope: Finite-motion ALE material-cut geometry, extensive transport, reciprocal pressure/viscous total-energy sources and finite-strain cut-material support. Component-only, no autonomous FSI field solve, contact or remeshing qualification.

packages.label: Compressible Euler transport and mechanics
packages.scope: Quasi-one-dimensional and Cartesian Euler transport, first-order and MUSCL topology derivatives, and one-way flow-to-solid loading. Provider validity limits apply.
